capabilities.name: Employee onboarding plan
capabilities.summary: Every new colleague starts with a first week and a first 90 days planned to the standard of your best manager: what to read, who to meet, what to practice and what productive means at day 30, 60 and 90.

capabilities.name: Manager feedback preparation
capabilities.summary: Every manager walks into a feedback conversation prepared like your best one: specific dated observations, the questions worth asking, a clear ask and the support on offer.
